description:
The tough steel hardtail frame provides lasting durability, ready to handle rugged trails and daily rides. With its sleek grey finish and bold graphics, this bike delivers both performance and style. Plus, it’s backed by a limited lifetime warranty for peace of mind.
The 15-speed twist shifter and indexed derailleur make gear changes effortless, whether climbing hills or cruising flat trails. Ride with confidence, knowing you have the right gear for any terrain.
The easy-to-use 15-speed twist shifter allows for smooth gear changes with a simple turn of the wrist. Paired with comfortable grips and responsive linear-pull brakes, you stay in control on any terrain.
The padded MTB saddle is designed for lasting comfort, whether you're hitting the trails or cruising the streets. With an adjustable seat post, you can easily find the perfect fit for your ride.

components.description: Confident Braking: Steel linear-pull brakes provide reliable stopping power when you need it most.
